exposure: First labor after prior cesarean delivery vs. subsequent labors
Trial of labor after cesarean delivery (TOLAC)
Grandmultiparous women (6th or higher birth) with one previous cesarean delivery
Presence vs. absence of shoulder dystocia
trial of labor after cesarean delivery (TOLAC)
cohort: 1922 grandmultiparous women (6th or higher birth) with one previous cesarean delivery
finding: The risk of uterine rupture in grandmultiparous women undergoing TOLAC was 0.3%, and labor induction did not increase this risk.
mod_finding: The study found that labor induction was not contraindicated for grandmultiparous women with one previous cesarean delivery.
